title: Moodiy script spec: flow.json
description: The manifest of one script flow, flows/<id>/flow.json. See docs/spec.md. A schema cannot check the rules that need the file system: the folder name must equal id, every step must name a script of the same repository, and the detail file must exist and be small enough. Run tools/validate.mjs for those. Fields this schema does not know are ignored by clients.

name.description: The name shown to people, one line.

detail.description: A path to a self-contained html file in the flow folder, at most 200 KB. It is shown to people and never installed.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; starts with a letter or a digit; at most 64 characters. The folder name is the same.

version.description: A string such as 1.0, 1.2.3 or 1.0-beta. A number is accepted too, but a number cannot keep a trailing zero (1.10 is read as 1.1), so write a string.

path.description: A relative path with / separators: no leading or trailing /, no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash, no control character.

script.description: The id of a script in the scripts folder of the same repository. The same script may be used by several steps.

abortIfError.description: Stop the flow if this step fails. Defaults to true.

pipeToNext.description: Hand the output of this step to the next step. Defaults to false.

args.description: The arguments of the step: named settings that the script gets in request.args. The user sets their values in Moodiy. At most 20, with names that are unique within the step.

arg.description: One argument of a step. A default, when given, must be of the declared type. A schema cannot say that names are unique within the step: tools/validate.mjs checks that.

name.description: An identifier, at most 64 characters. Unique within the step.

default.description: The value used when the user has not set one. An integer for int, true or false for bool, a string of at most 4096 characters for string. Without a default and without a value, the argument is absent from request.args.
